# MyPokePanion

> MyPokePanion is an unofficial Pokémon fan project: an interactive, living
> Pokédex with team builder, Nuzlocke tracker, Versus damage calculator and
> interactive region maps. Free to use, available in German and English
> (URL prefixes /de and /en). Not affiliated with Nintendo, Game Freak or
> The Pokémon Company.

## Sections

- [Pokédex](https://mypokepanion.com/en/pokedex): all 1,025 Pokémon across 9 generations — stats, types, abilities, moves, evolutions, sprites
- [Items](https://mypokepanion.com/en/items): every item with effects, prices and locations
- [Interactive Maps](https://mypokepanion.com/en/maps): regions, routes and encounter tables
- [Nuzlocke Tracker](https://mypokepanion.com/en/nuzlocke): track encounters, teams and deaths for challenge runs
- [Team Builder](https://mypokepanion.com/en/team): build teams with type coverage and weakness analysis
- [Versus Calculator](https://mypokepanion.com/en/versus): damage calculator and 1v1 Pokémon comparison
- [About](https://mypokepanion.com/en/about): project background
- [Feedback](https://mypokepanion.com/en/feedback): bug reports and feature requests
- [Donate](https://mypokepanion.com/en/support): support the project

## Notes

- German versions of all pages live under https://mypokepanion.com/de/…
